description:
The live board — every hive, every bee, and when to ask again.

Poll this rather than guessing a cadence: the answer carries `poll_after_ms`,
computed from how hot the match actually is. One algorithm, owned here, so
sixty clients throttle themselves and the server keeps a valve it can turn.

match_id.description: The match to read. Omit for the live one.

next_round.description: You have finished reading your last result — answer with the lobby that is forming rather than the round you just played.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

since_seq.description: Only answer if the board has moved past this.
